component.name: SidebarFrame
component.description: Sidebar + main frame with mobile Sheet support and desktop layout wrappers.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Frame container that coordinates sidebar and main content layout.

slots.name: sidebar
slots.description: Sidebar region rendered inline on desktop or inside a sheet on mobile.

slots.name: sidebarHeader
slots.description: Optional header region at the top of the sidebar.

slots.name: sidebarFooter
slots.description: Optional footer region at the bottom of the sidebar.

slots.name: main
slots.description: Primary content region beside or beneath the sidebar.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: frameRender
own.description: Optional frame renderer used to compose sidebar/main layout.

own.name: isMobile
own.description:
Controlled mobile mode state.
When omitted, mobile state is resolved from `matchMedia`.

own.name: mainRender
own.description: Render function for main content section.

own.name: sidebarBodyRender
own.description: Render function for sidebar body section.

own.name: sidebarFooterRender
own.description: Optional render function for sidebar footer section.

own.name: sidebarHeaderRender
own.description: Optional render function for sidebar header section.
